Bose2006.title: Area-preserving approximations of polygonal paths
Bose2006.verified_content: For vertex-subset x-monotone paths, treats sum-area, max-area and difference-area objectives. These correspond to eta, xi and absolute terminal signed error. This is established area-measure literature; WorkCert does not introduce these geometric objectives.

Daneshpajouh2012.title: Computing polygonal path simplification under area measures
Daneshpajouh2012.verified_content: Studies restricted simplifications of general simple paths under area measures; distinguishes sum-area and difference-area and uses maximum shortcut cost. It is related literature, not a directly applicable solver for the self-intersecting cyclic record or the global prefix objective.

CyclicPaper2022.title: Experimental study on stainless steel tubular members under cyclic loading
CyclicPaper2022.verified_content: Section 2.4 uses stepped displacement control adapted from ANSI/AISC 341. Initial amplitude groups have six, six, six, four, two and two cycles, then two cycles per increment. Table 3 reports S1-L1 initial corner cracking at cycle 43 and failure at cycle 47. The string potentiometer measures top-end horizontal displacement; the deposited record is not a synchronized command history.

CyclicDataset2024.verified_content: S1-L1, austenitic stainless steel 120x80x6 mm RHS, effective length 1650 mm; horizontal force from actuator and displacement from a string potentiometer at the free end.
